title: Chapter 993
text:
After reaching a consensus on the matter regarding the Modo Civilization, the two of them talked about the Flickering World for a while before turning to casual conversation.

"Recently, the dynasty's Science Academy has been learning about the Spacetime Splicing Technology. A few of my old friends in the Science Academy told me that this will be a new research direction for the theory of spacetime and will allow us to obtain a new trump card in spacetime. This is all thanks to you."

Tarrokov took a sip of tea and casually chatted with him.

"That's a good thing. However, even without me, the dynasty would still be able to obtain this technology." Han Xiao lowered his head and looked at the cup in his hand. He could not help but look at Old Tarrokov, who was drinking his tea.

Noticing Han Xiao's gaze, Tarrokov put down the cup and coughed.

"The Radiant Federation has a strategic technology like the Multi-Dimensional Sky Opening Transportation Device in the spacetime aspect, and our dynasty's research on spacetime is inferior to theirs. The Spacetime Splicing Technology that we obtained this time might become a representative technology of the dynasty in the future. Thus, it is inevitable that we have to keep it a secret. "

"I know. This technology will not be leaked out from my hands." Han Xiao nodded.

In his previous life, the Spacetime Splicing Technology was monopolized by the dynasty. Now that he had obtained this technology, the dynasty could not monopolize it and could only accept it. He only requested that Han Xiao not leak any information.

During this period, Han Xiao's level and attributes did not increase by much, but he had obtained many powerful abilities and talents. If the Mecha Empire made a comeback and infiltrated his database like the previous time, he would not be afraid anymore. He would not make the same mistake and let the Mecha Empire steal all his intelligence.

Tarrokov suddenly thought of something and smiled. "Speaking of which, the Spacetime Splicing Technology is the greatest wealth of the Kunde Race. The Modo Civilization is clearly one step ahead of us, but they missed out on this technology because they wanted to kill us with a borrowed knife. They are still in the dark and do not know what they missed out on.

"If the Modo Civilization knew that not only did their plan harm them, but they also gave the dynasty a huge fortune, they would probably regret it to death."

Seeing that the Modo Civilization had gone for wool and come home shorn, both of them laughed happily.

After laughing for a while, Tarrokov changed the topic and suddenly changed the topic. "With my status, it might not be appropriate for me to talk to you about this, but I still want to ask you … what plans do you have for your marriage?"

Han Xiao's expression suddenly became strange.

What? You want to be a matchmaker?

With our identities, it's not good for you to ask me such a private question.

Tarrokov's expression was a little awkward, but he still continued, "The dynasty values the alliance with you and pays close attention to your life. You might not know, but you are very popular among the children of the dynasty's upper echelons. Many of them want to get to know you."

Seeing his helpless expression, Han Xiaoxin suddenly understood.

The Universal Civilizations would not interfere with the private lives of the Beyond Grade As. However, the Black Star Corps and the Red Empire were currently in the honeymoon phase of cooperation. The potential that Black Star had displayed had already caused countless upper echelons to place their hopes on him. Furthermore, Han Xiao had always been a golden bachelor, so the idea of a marriage alliance had started to surface. However, it could not be forced.

The dynasty did not have a royal family, but a marriage alliance was still a method that would never go out of date. Some of the upper echelons had such thoughts, and others were also happy to see it happen. With a marriage alliance, the relationship between Black Star and the dynasty would change qualitatively. This way, the issue of the Evolution Cube would also be easier to deal with. After the marriage alliance, the upper echelons would not find it too difficult to accept letting Black Star keep the Evolution Cube.

On the other hand, the Universal Civilizations had always valued the Beyond Grade A races. This was the cradle of Supers, and the dynasty also wanted Han Xiao to leave behind his descendants as soon as possible.

Simply put, they were urging him to get married.

The idea of a marriage alliance might not be Uranril's idea. It was probably many of the upper echelons who found Tarrokov and asked him to pass a message to me, saying that they wanted to give their daughters to me … Han Xiao thought to himself.

Seeing that Han Xiao was not speaking, Tarrokov could only brace himself and continue. "If you have time, you can also attend some of the banquets held by the dynasty's upper echelons. Many of their children would like to get to know you."

Just to get to know me?

They probably want to sleep with me!

Humph, boys have to protect themselves when they're outside. I won't give them a chance.

"Let's talk about this in the future." Han Xiao laughed and changed the topic. "Has the dynasty made any other movements recently?"

"Let me think …" Tarrokov pondered for a moment. "By the way, a Beyond Grade A from the Arcane Church has not appeared for a long time. It's not normal."

"Who is it?" Han Xiao had not been paying attention to this recently.

"Ninjia. Do you still remember him? He was also one of the members who attacked Planet Lighthouse. He was the only one who managed to escape with the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter."

"Oh, it's him." Han Xiao recalled. That group of Beyond Grade As had all been sealed in amber, and only Ninjia had survived.

"Ninjia has never appeared in public in the past few years, and the Arcane Church claimed that Ninjia had been resting. However, as time passed, the situation became more and more suspicious. Even if he was resting, there's no reason for him to not appear in public in the past ten years. There might be more to this …"

"Is the Arcane Church lying?" Han Xiao raised his brows.

"Hmm, I feel that Ninjia might have gone missing or even died. From this point of view, I feel that Ninjia might not have returned to the Arcane Church with the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter. Someone killed him," Tarrokov said solemnly.

"You mean … the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter is actually not in the hands of the Arcane Church, but they're pretending that they have it?"

Han Xiao stroked his chin and said, "Makes sense. Over the past few years, I've already unsealed the Beyond Grade As of the Arcane Church, but they have not requested to unseal the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter. They said that they thought that the dynasty would definitely not agree to it. However, thinking about it, this is very strange."

"That's right." Tarrokov shook his head. "However, it doesn't matter who has the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter. Without your help, no one will be able to use the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter and pose a threat to us."

"Hmm …" Han Xiao pondered and said, "If that's the case, the dynasty will be the only one who can use it. We might even have a chance to exchange the Ten Thousand Deity Scepter from someone else. This way, one of the trump cards of the Arcane Church will become our weapon."

"It won't be that easy. We still have to see what the upper echelons think." Tarrokov was not optimistic.

The two of them chatted for a while. Tarrokov had a regular meeting, so Han Xiao did not disturb him.

Han Xiao deactivated the remote projection, and his vision returned to his own room. Thinking back to the conversation earlier, Han Xiao muttered to himself, "The Mogadorian Civilization will only target the Mogadorian Civilization.

"Our revenge against the Modo Civilization will have to wait until the fourth exploration phase. Let's make more preparations before the start of Version 4.0."

As he said that, Han Xiao opened Philip's database and looked at the current size of the Black Star Corps.

After all these years of development, the Black Star Corps had stabilized their position as the leader of the Shattered Star Ring. Although they had met some challenges, as long as he was around, their position would not be shaken so easily. In the Flickering World, the army had also obtained a territory and had a lot of room for development.

In the other Star Fields, the Black Star Corps had more or less established branches, but their scale could not be compared to the Shattered Star Ring and Flickering World. Their main forces were still in those two Star Fields.

Now that the second exploration phase was back on track, although there would be more people entering the third exploration phase, without an obstacle like the Kunde Race, the universe would be able to develop steadily for more than ten years. It would only become restless in the fourth exploration phase.

During this period, the army will have enough time to build in the Flickering World and gradually perfect all aspects of the territory. The Machinery Civilization and the Black Spirit Race will also be able to develop greatly. The same goes for the Kunde Race's modification.

Han Xiao thought to himself. These were all important chips for the army to develop to the next stage.

He could not help but think about the external pressure he was facing.

Needless to say, the Mecha Empire had a conflict of interest that was difficult to resolve. The Limitless Financial Group had always been fighting for the market and would probably not stop. The dynasty was facing the problem of the Evolutionary Totem, but it was not easy for him either. The World Tree coordinates were also a ticking time bomb that could topple the entire universe at any time.

"Now that the Modo Civilization has been added to the list, there are really many problems that need to be dealt with."

Han Xiao shook his head and let out a sigh.

There were many enemies, and they were extremely powerful. In order to deal with them, his faction and personal strength were indispensable.

"When the players return, my combat strength will quickly increase again. Only then will I be able to deal with these problems more securely." Han Xiao nodded. Although his efficiency of earning experience was not low, it could not be compared to the terrifying speed of harvesting leeks.

He did not plan to just wait. Since he could not level up, he planned to use this time to explore how to create Universal Treasures. A Mechanic would always have a way to increase his strength.

It was already very good for a Beyond Grade A to have one Universal Treasure, but Han Xiao had two. He did not mind having a third.

"Speaking of which, the next batch of Beyond Grade As will be born in Version 4.0 … Heh, I've become a senior."

Han Xiao shook his head and smiled. Thinking of this, he could not help but think of Hella, who was cultivating in seclusion.

It had been a while since they last met, and he missed her a little. Ever since they left that small place called Blue Star, the two of them rarely met.

"She'll probably be able to step into the Beyond Grade A realm in Version 4.0, allowing the Goddess of Death to reappear in the universe."

Han Xiao had high hopes for Hella. Among the officers, the one with the highest chance of becoming a Beyond Grade A was Hella.

Hardaway, Lothaire, Fu Ding, and Lagi also had potential, but they were still too far away from becoming a Beyond Grade A.

"Maybe I can think of a way to strengthen the officers of the army."

Han Xiao thought about it and pulled out a piece of information. This was EsGod's inheritance, information about the [Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy].

According to the information, the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy would appear in Version 4.0. Although he could not use this special Esper Ability, it would not stop him from capturing it and slowly finding a suitable host.

This opportunity was very rare, and he did not plan to miss it.

…

Red Empire territory, a certain transit hub in the Constellation Corridor.

The strip club was lively and noisy, and the music was deafening. However, in a remote booth in the corner, the atmosphere was completely different.

The two of them sat opposite each other. One of them was wearing a hooded windbreaker, so no one could see what he looked like. The other was an intelligent creature covered in lumps. He looked a little like an upright toad and wore a pair of glasses.

"This is what you want." The toadman took out a small memory chip, pushed it in front of the other party, and said in a low voice, "The information is all in there. Find a matching machine to check it."

"Hmm." The hooded man took the chip and pretended to leave.

This time, the toadman could not help but stop him and ask with a deep voice, "I don't understand. I've been clean for many years and have long cut off contact with the people in the intelligence organization. Very few people know my identity. How did you find me? Who are you? "

The hooded man's voice was hoarse as he said coldly,

"Don't you think it's redundant to ask the identity of a person who's covered his face?"

Then, he strode out of the transaction site, took a few turns in the hub, and quietly boarded a galactic flight, leaving this place.

In the cabin, he took off his hood and revealed a pale face. It was Gaud.

He took out a machine, disconnected from the network, and inserted the memory chip he bought from a special person. Very soon, a piece of information appeared on the screen.

After looking at it for a while, Gaud's lips curled up.

"That's right, it's information about the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy …"

—

Ps: Happy Chinese Valentine's Day. I wanted to take a leave of absence for a date, but I suddenly realized that I don't have a girlfriend, so I'll just write my story.
